name: claude-quota-bar
description: Claude Code weekly quota in the status bar, with the theoretical uniform pace overlaid on the bar

commands.title: Claude Quota: show web page URL (for phone/browser)

claudeQuotaBar.pollMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) to query the usage endpoint. The endpoint is shared with Claude Code: low values lead to 429s and backoff.

claudeQuotaBar.showFiveHour.description: Also show the 5-hour window next to the weekly one.

enumDescriptions: Thin line in the status bar's text color (the original marker)
claudeQuotaBar.paceMarker.description: Marker for the theoretical uniform pace. The colored squares are emoji, so they keep their own color regardless of the status bar theme.

claudeQuotaBar.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar to appear on.

claudeQuotaBar.priority.description: Priority within the status bar: higher sits further left within its group.

claudeQuotaBar.webServer.enabled.description: Serve a web page with the same bar, to check the quota from a phone or another device's browser. It only exposes quota percentages, never the token, but anyone who can reach the port can see them.

claudeQuotaBar.webServer.host.description: Address the web page listens on: 0.0.0.0 to reach it from other devices on the network, 127.0.0.1 for this machine only (or behind a tunnel such as Tailscale/SSH).
